description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Applied Physics topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: applied-physics

facts.claim: Restoring force proportional to displacement, towards equilibrium

source.quote: restoring force whose magnitude is directly proportional to the distance of the object from an equilibrium position

facts.claim: The motion is sinusoidal in time

source.quote: The motion is sinusoidal in time

facts.claim: Underdamped, critically damped and overdamped cases

source.quote: underdamped (ζ < 1) through critically damped (ζ = 1) to overdamped (ζ > 1)

facts.claim: Amplitude decays inside an exponential envelope

source.quote: the outer envelope of the successive peaks is an exponential decay curve

facts.claim: Driving at the resonant frequency gives the largest amplitude

source.quote: defined as a frequency that generates a maximum amplitude response in the system

facts.claim: With little damping, resonance is near the natural frequency

source.quote: When damping is small, the resonant frequency is approximately equal to the natural frequency of the system

facts.claim: Nodes have zero amplitude, antinodes maximum

source.quote: the locations where the absolute value of the amplitude is maximum are called antinodes

facts.claim: Adjacent nodes are half a wavelength apart

source.quote: The distance between two consecutive nodes or anti-nodes is half the wavelength

facts.claim: Constructive (in phase) and destructive (out of phase) interference

source.quote: may have greater amplitude (constructive interference) or lower amplitude (destructive interference)

source.quote: Constructive interference occurs when the phase difference between the waves is an even multiple of π

facts.claim: Fraunhofer diffraction is viewed far away (or with a lens)

source.quote: the diffraction pattern is viewed at a sufficiently long distance

facts.claim: Most light falls in the central maximum between the first minima

source.quote: Most of the diffracted light falls between the first minima

facts.claim: More atoms in the upper (excited) state than the lower

facts.claim: A population inversion is necessary for laser action

source.quote: the production of a population inversion is a necessary step in the workings of a standard laser

facts.claim: At thermal equilibrium most atoms are in the ground state

source.quote: the majority of the atoms will be in the ground state
